Terms & Conditions

Website information, your choices and our responsibilities.

Draft for company review. Prepared for the current website on 8 October 2026. Company approval and legal review are pending.

Privacy PolicyCookie PolicyTerms & ConditionsRecruitment Disclaimer

1. About this website

This website provides information about GA Digital Web Word Pvt. Ltd., its workforce-related services, office contacts and published opportunities. These terms concern website use. A signed service agreement, employment contract or applicable recruitment notification governs the relevant engagement and takes priority for that engagement.

2. Using the information

Content is provided for general information and may change. Confirm availability, scope, eligibility, timelines and commercial terms directly with the company before relying on information for a decision. An enquiry or website visit does not create a service contract, appointment, job offer or guarantee of a response.

3. Acceptable use

Use the site lawfully. Do not attempt unauthorized access, disrupt its availability, introduce malicious code, impersonate another person or submit misleading or unlawfully obtained information. Do not use contact details for spam or harassment. You are responsible for the accuracy and lawful sharing of information you choose to send.

4. Enquiries and communications

The enquiry tool prepares an email draft or downloadable text file. It does not send a message automatically. Review the recipient and content before sending through your email provider. Service proposals and commitments must be confirmed by an authorized company representative through the appropriate business process.

5. Recruitment information

Vacancy summaries are provided for navigation. The original notification governs eligibility, deadlines, application steps and any stated terms. A listed or archived vacancy is not proof of a current opening. Do not rely on a website listing as a job offer. Read the Recruitment Disclaimer and Recruitment Fraud Alert, and verify doubtful communications through company contact channels.

6. Content, names and intellectual property

Website content and assets may belong to GA Digital, their original creators or other rights holders. Organization names, logos and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners. Portfolio listings do not imply endorsement or a current contract. Do not reuse content beyond permission, licence terms or rights provided by applicable law.

7. Illustrations and draft content

Profiles, portraits, testimonials, messages or policy text explicitly labelled illustrative, sample or draft are provided for review and are not verified statements or endorsements. Theme previews are alternative presentations of the same website content. Certification scope and validity should be confirmed with the company.

8. Third-party services

Google Maps, email applications, external profile pages and vacancy documents are operated independently. Their availability, content and privacy practices are governed by their own providers. Linking to them does not guarantee their accuracy or availability.

9. Availability and responsibility

The site may be updated, interrupted or unavailable. No promise is made that it will be uninterrupted or free from errors. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the company does not accept responsibility for losses caused solely by reliance on general website information or independently operated third-party services. Nothing in these terms excludes any liability or right that cannot lawfully be excluded.

10. Privacy, questions and changes

Read the Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy for website data handling. Raise website questions or concerns at info@gadigital.in or 0120-4218525. Postal address: S-14, 2nd Floor, Aditya Mall, Indirapuram, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh – 201014. Applicable law and any separate agreement govern legal rights and disputes. Updates should carry a revised date; changes do not override mandatory legal rights or separately agreed contractual terms.
